## Why

What problem or experimental question does this change address?

## Result

What can a user now do or understand? What does this preserve for the next rung?

## Evidence

Checks performed and their results. For scientific changes: assumptions, reference, observables, horizon, tolerances, errors, and relevant costs. State limits and checks not run.

## Compatibility

Any changes to experiment identity, saved formats, provenance, model correspondence, or recovery behavior? Write “none” when not applicable.
